note: Wave status the deck reads. Written by the orchestrator when an agent is launched and when it reports. The deck shows the `asOf` stamp rather than implying live polling — a published page cannot see this session, and pretending otherwise is the same failure as a screen rendering a total it did not compute.
waveNote: Tranche 2 running: server hardening on the tranche-1 findings (F-014 through F-018 — the qc role that cannot operate its own gate and the technician who cannot see their own jobs are both fixed here, plus the inventory prohibitions the server never enforced), and three product domains chosen for zero file contention with each other: procurement, portals, website.
